name: NYS Tax Parcels Public
organization: NYS Office of Information Technology Services, GIS Program Office
notes: Layer /0 is municipal boundaries (NYS_Tax_Parcels_Public_Footprint); parcels are /1 -- check layer `name` before ingesting. PRIMARY_OWNER names identifiable people and companies: do not publish owner identity at property level without a correction path. Niagara County NY is NOT in this dataset (verified by exact match, LIKE, and distinct-value query).

name: Designated Brownfield Opportunity Areas
notes: November 2021 designation snapshot, not a live register -- must be labelled HISTORICAL. Authoritative replacement for the landuse=brownfield OSM proxy used on the Ontario side.

name: NYS DEC regulated facility registries
notes: A permit is positive evidence that a specific industrial PROCESS occurs at a location -- a stronger signal than OSM's building=industrial, which only says something looks industrial. Per-county counts not yet checked.

name: NYS DOT Truck AADT and Percentage Truck
notes: Measured truck volumes. No Canadian counterpart found: Hamilton publishes a truck ROUTE network (where trucks may go), New York publishes VOLUMES (how many actually pass). The two are not comparable and must not be styled alike.

name: US Census County Business Patterns
requires_key: CENSUS_API_KEY environment variable, only to pull a NEW vintage; free from api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html. NEVER commit it -- this repo is public.
notes: Tabular, not geospatial: establishment and employment counts by NAICS by county. Informs weighting and validation, does not become a map layer. The one source that could put Hamilton, Niagara Region and the two US counties on a comparable NAICS footing.

name: data-ecgis.opendata.arcgis.com
notes: NOT Erie County, New York. Returns a plausible ArcGIS Hub with 78 datasets including 'Eaton County ORV Approved Roads'. Recorded so this near-miss is not repeated.
